name: ANSI/IEEE fuse symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for fuse, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The fuse representation identifies a sacrificial protective element in a conductor path. The drawing requires its fuse designation and selected link data; a compact outline cannot establish the time-current category, voltage rating or breaking capacity.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace the conductor through the protective element rather than treating its outline as a terminal.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A fuse graphic represents a fuse-link function; a fuse-switch includes an operating assembly as well.
